newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines lowers weekly treasury bill volume.
newsitem.headline: Philippines lowers weekly treasury bill volume.

text.p: The Philippine Bureau of Treasury said on Tuesday it will reduce the volume of its weekly auction of Treasury bills to 3.5 billion pesos from 5.0 billion pesos.

At next Monday's auction, the volume of six-month bills will be cut to 1.0 billion pesos from 1.5 billion pesos; and the one-year to 1.5 billion pesos from 2.5 billion. The offering of three-month bills will stay at 1.0 billion pesos, the agency said.
Dealers said the lower volume was in line with the government's programme to reduce borrowings because of its budget surplus position.
